sample_rule: Input-only deterministic per-date sample BEFORE looking at label/sequence availability; same mature complete-sequence fit rows for every arm. Full input-eligible pool at inference; never reduce final candidates.
missing_sequence_rule: Keep candidate and use the last_mlp raw ensemble as an explicitly counted fallback; no zero-filled invented history.
calibration_rule: Separate purged period; scalar sigmoid calibration of equal-weight seed mean raw probability; no seed/model/epoch selection using external outcomes.
evaluation_role: Repeatedly inspected historical development periods; not an untouched final test.
